Casual Dresses

Trendy and Casual Dress

If you can rock a dress, then why wouldn't you? They're pretty standard for special occasions, but truthfully, we'll take any opportunity to slip into our favorite one-and-done frock. That's why we keep our shop stocked with tons of casual dresses that will make any day better. Whether you're heading to the beach or the park, or you're simply looking for something you can sport while running weekend errands or brunching, you've come to the right place — so let's keep it casual.

Our collection of casual dresses for women currently includes must-haves like drawstring-waist dresses, tiered babydoll styles, button-front dresses, puff sleeve dresses, and mini dresses in breezy fabrics like cotton and linen blends. If you prefer a fitted shape, choose an easy style like a jersey t-shirt dress or ribbed tank dress (just add sneakers or flat sandals!). Prints like stripes, ditsy floral prints, gingham, denim, and tie dye all add to the laid-back vibe, as well. The less structured the dress is, the more casual it feels. Fashionably unfussy? That's you.
